message.content:
I want to split config parsing in crates/config-core into a RawConfig stage and a validation stage. Don't change the public signature of `Config::load`. Never run `cargo update`; the lockfile is pinned for the 2.4 release.
Always run `cargo test -p config-core` before you say something is done.

data.objective: Split config-core parsing into RawConfig + validation without changing Config::load

content.text: Plan: introduce `RawConfig` in a new module `raw.rs`; `parse.rs` produces it and `validate.rs` turns it into `Config`. I'll keep `toml_edit` instead of switching to `serde_toml`, because its spans give line numbers for errors.

message.content: Sounds good. Only touch files under crates/config-core/ — the CLI crate is owned by another team.
